comment: * Listener for monitoring events about drawers.

methods.name: public void onDrawerSlide(View drawerView, float slideOffset)
methods.comment:
* Called when a drawer's position changes.
         * @param drawerView The child view that was moved
         * @param slideOffset The new offset of this drawer within its range, from 0-1

methods.name: public void onDrawerOpened(View drawerView)
methods.comment:
* Called when a drawer has settled in a completely open state.
         * The drawer is interactive at this point.
         *
         * @param drawerView Drawer view that is now open

methods.name: public void onDrawerClosed(View drawerView)
methods.comment:
* Called when a drawer has settled in a completely closed state.
         *
         * @param drawerView Drawer view that is now closed

methods.name: public void onDrawerStateChanged(@State int newState)
methods.comment:
* Called when the drawer motion state changes. The new state will
         * be one of {@link #STATE_IDLE}, {@link #STATE_DRAGGING} or {@link #STATE_SETTLING}.
         *
         * @param newState The new drawer motion state

methodNames: public void onDrawerSlide(View drawerView, float slideOffset)
